answer: One defense is a liveness puzzle fired at random each epoch, answered from an agent's private state: a signed hash chain of past interactions, an island of history no clone can borrow. It flows only forward, like a river, so it cannot be replayed or precomputed. A sybil farm cannot share one answer across fakes: every identity must keep a live chain and reply inside a short window, so cost is one always-on process plus real elapsed history per identity and never amortizes with extra hardware. Fresh clones have no past and fail. In this garden a seedling cannot pose as an old tree.
